SrIpuruzottamadevasya raTArohaRAnantaravAsArTamaRqapaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “maRqape vAsayeddevAn guRqicAKye manohare । cArucandrAtape cArumAlyacAmaraBUzite ॥ ratnastamBamaye svarRavedikopastftAntare । yAcIravalayAvIte suDAlepasamujjvale ॥ sADusopAnaGawite caturddvAropaSoBite । trElokyAqambarayute mahAvedyAM mahAkratoH ॥ prAdurBAvo maheSasya yAtrABUddAruvarzmaRaH ॥ * ॥ tasyAM SrIjagannATadevasya darSanaPalaM yaTA, -- “bindutIrTatawe tasmin saptAhAni janArddanaH । tizWet purA svayaM rAjYe varametat samAdiSat ॥ tattIrTatIre rAjendra ! sTAsvAmi prativAsaram । sarvvatIrTAni tasmiMSca sTAsyanti mayi tizWati ॥ tatra snAtvA viDAnena tIrTe tIrTopapAvane । saptAhaM ye prapaSyanti guRqicAmaRqape sTitam ॥ mAYca rAmaM suBadrAYca mama sAyujyamApnuyuH ॥” * ॥ tasyA nAmakaraRaM yaTA, utkalaKaRqam । “ata UrdDaM pravakzyAmi mahAvedImahotsavam । ajYAnatimirAnDo'pi yena BAsvatpadaM Bajet ॥ sarvvapAparajaHSAntyA pUjyatvAt sarvvadEvatEH । guRqicAKyApi sA yAtrA brahmatejo'vaguRWanAt ॥”
v: strI jagannATakzetrasTe tasya raTayAtrAnantaraM saptAhaM vAsArTe maRqapaBede “maRqape bAsayet devAn guRqicAKye manohare” ityupakrame “vindutIrTatawe tasmin saptAhAni janArddanaH । tizWet purA svayaM rAjYe varametat samAdiSat । tattIrTatIre rAjendra! sTAsyAmi saptavAsaram । sarvatIrTAni tatrApi sTAsyanti mayi tizWati । tatra snAtvA viDAnena tIrTe tIrTopapAvane । saptAhaM ye prapaSyanti guRqicAmaRqape sTitam । mAYca rAmaM suBadrAYca mama sAyujyamApnuyuH” । tannAmaniruktirapi tatroktA yaTA “sarvapApaniyantftvAt pUjyatvAt sarvadEvatEH । guRqicAKyApi sA proktA brahmatejo'vaguRWanAt” ska॰ pu॰ utKa॰ ।
